Contact Us

Spotted an error, have a correction, or want to suggest a guide we haven't written yet? We read every message and use your feedback to keep the wiki accurate and useful.

Email us

The fastest way to reach us is by email. We aim to reply within a few days.

hello@beastreincarnationwiki.com

What to include

To help us act on your message quickly, it helps to include:

  • Corrections — the guide URL and what you believe is inaccurate, ideally with what you saw in-game.
  • Guide requests — the boss, enemy, region, or mechanic you'd like covered.
  • General feedback — anything about the site that worked well or got in your way.

A note on scope

Beast of Reincarnation Wiki is an unofficial, fan-made resource. We can't help with account issues, purchases, or technical support for the game itself — those need to go through the game's official channels. For anything about our guides and this site, though, we'd love to hear from you.
